source: strafe-prototype docs/dnhacks_engineering_direction_2026-09-05.md §3.5 (event kinds; actor discipline); lane ADR-0003
rules: kinds ending _proposed are the only kinds an agent may write

offer_selected, match_adjudicated, technical_data_declared, escalation_resolved, rule_pack_committed, intent_memo_signed, order_dispatched, swap_confirmed require actor_kind = human and a non-null attestor
sourcing and order events bind design_hash, design_seq and fixture_shas; proposal events also bind pool_sha256, rules_sha256 and prompt_sha256
note: The lane's Thread is a stand-in for the platform log (ADR-0003); events carry over unchanged when the log lands.
